scope: production DR10 optical finite-frame selection before production optical population processing; no validation kinematics or Gate outcomes used
backend: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10 direct NERSC south coadd g/r/z images
grid_rule: For each tested size, define the target WCS as an exact integer-pixel extension of the geometrically containing DR10 brick. Pixels owned by that containing brick are copied without interpolation; only pixels geometrically owned by neighbouring bricks are bilinearly reprojected. No overlap averaging.
selection_rule: Choose the smallest tested frame N for which N and the next larger registered frame are both fully contained and the N->next step satisfies every convergence criterion. If no adjacent pair passes through 3072 pixels, classify the optical processing as frame_nonconverged_after_registered_ladder; do not tune a larger size or alter thresholds after response opening.
containment_rule: The common uncertainty aperture semi-major radius must be no larger than the orientation-independent inscribed radius from the fitted r-band centre to the nearest frame edge minus 2 pixels.
profile_rule: r-band AutoProf geometry with forced g/z; retain common profile rows strictly interior to the first row where any band SB_e is non-finite or >=0.22 mag arcsec^-2.
network_rule: Network/download failures remain unresolved and must be retried; they are not converted into astrophysical full_stellar=false classifications merely because retries in one workflow run were exhausted.
coverage_rule: A confirmed absence of DR10 imaging in one or more required g/r/z bands is a source-side optical completeness failure under the frozen all-three-band full_stellar gate; no substitute survey is permitted.
qc_rule: AutoProf checkfit booleans are diagnostic metadata only and are not hard cuts.
firewall: This lock does not authorize opening any validation kinematic catalogue or response product. Stage-1 remains unearned until the complete source-only predictor, baryonic H I fold, optical/stellar metadata, beam/recovery report and hashes are externally timestamped.
